name: cortico-world-coo-gen
description: Cortico World: user-initiated image generation through a local ComfyUI. The person owns the prompt, checkpoint, LoRA and parameters; results are saved into a local folder and can be triggered from chat or from a full panel.

zh.description: 用本地 ComfyUI 出用户自己的图：面板里选模型、LoRA、采样参数，或在对话里说一句就开画。LoRA 自动扫描、可设别名和常驻组合，结果存进本地文件夹并写进 PNG 元数据。

en.description: Generate the user's own pictures with a local ComfyUI: choose checkpoint, LoRAs and sampler settings in the panel, or ask in chat. Scans LoRAs, supports aliases and always-on stacks, saves results locally with PNG metadata.
